# zucbor

The goal of zucbor is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zucbor from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zucbor")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zucbor)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cbor_validate()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zucbor/reference/cbor_validate.md)
  : Validate CBOR
- [`zucbor-conditions`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zucbor/reference/zucbor-conditions.md)
  : Conditions raised by zucbor
- [`zucbor_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zucbor/reference/zucbor_info.md)
  : Build information
